    source=loop.create_future();destination=loop.create_future()
    chain_future(source,destination)
    source.set_result(7)
    assert await asyncio.wait_for(destination,1)==7
    was_enabled=gc.isenabled();gc.disable()
    try:
        pending=loop.create_future();reference=weakref.ref(pending)
        chain_future(pending,loop.create_future())
        del pending
        print('pending source collected without cyclic GC:',reference() is None)
        assert reference() is None,'callback retained a cycle to pending source Future'
    finally:
        if was_enabled:gc.enable()
        gc.collect()
asyncio.run(observe())
